correctness.rationale: For a generic normal, sorted base projections have gaps x,y and vertical separation s. Exactly five prism edges are crossed for an offset interval of length s-(s-x)_+-(s-y)_++(s-x-y)_+. Spherical normal integration transforms its positive-part terms to a difference of arctangents in projected gaps X,Y. The total intersecting plane mass is pi(P+2h) by directional width integration; hence p5=I_T(h)/[pi(P+2h)]. Counting expected edge crossings gives p3=p5+2h/(P+2h) and p4=P/(P+2h)-2p5. Local analysis at six projection-gap degeneracies gives thin deficit pi h^2 sum(1/a_i), and a uniform large-h arctangent expansion gives C(T)=sum |edge1||edge2|(sin(alpha)-alpha cos(alpha))/pi>0. Independently integrated the formula and counted all nine actual prism-edge intersections for a scalene base at h=0.2,0.7,1.8 over a 360x96 spherical grid; all agree within 5.2e-5. Also cross-checked six equilateral heights against separately derived closed form to floating error ~1e-15. These are bounded corroborations of the analytic argument.
